d: Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure!  Equip the local warriors with custom swords, bows, shields and more in your hands-on blacksmith shop.  Follow the soldiers into battle as you push onward toward the evil wizard Dudley!

rv.t: 어릴적 피시방에서 할 게임이 없으면 플래시게임으로 했던 내 추억가득 대장장이소새끼게임
